The $2 \times 8$ matrix $B$ can be viewed as two $2 \times 4$ blocks $B_1$ and $B_2$.

Each product is a $2 \times 2$ matrix times a $2 \times 4$ matrix.
The tensor for $2 \times 2 \times 4$ has rank $2 \cdot 2 \cdot 4 = 16$ for schoolbook.
